solutionSql:
SELECT s.id,
       c.name AS customer_name,
       w.city AS origin_city,
       d.name AS driver_name
FROM shipments s
JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
JOIN routes r ON r.id = s.route_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = r.origin_id
LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.id = s.driver_id
WHERE s.id BETWEEN 1 AND 12
ORDER BY s.id;
notes: Shipments 1 and 8 have no driver, so driver_name is NULL and the LEFT JOIN keeps them. Origin city comes from the route's origin warehouse, as in c4-i4.
